pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions within 5 minutes or 2 points of a prior losing entry to prevent cascading drawdowns on falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic data releases; entries require confirmation via an ATR-weighted volume breakout filter.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly lock in floating profits via trailing stops once gains reach +$15.00 to eliminate premature profit evaporation.
